 LIVE UPDATES: Ohio State at USC in LA Memorial Coliseum
 Spencer Holbrook @ SpencerHolbrook 45m 0 Share Share 
 LOS ANGELES — Ohio State takes on USC on the West Coast in a Big Ten battle inside the Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum on Saturday night.
 The Buckeyes are playing without starting quarterback Julian Sayin for the first time this year, while the Trojans are trying to bounce back from an embarrassing road loss to Wisconsin.
 Follow along for live updates, scores, highlights and more as they happen.
 By: Spencer Holbrook Touchdown, USC
 10/31/2026 07:08:16 PM It’s 14-3 Trojans after a 9-yard run from Waymond Jordan. 
 It was set up by a disaster punt return coverage attempt from the Buckeyes, who also got a Beau Atkinson 15-yard late hit on the end of it. USC started the drive at the Ohio State 31.
 By: Spencer Holbrook Ohio State hits 39-yard field goal
 10/31/2026 07:07:54 PM Connor Hawkins drills a kick from 39 yards out. It’s 7-3.
 By: Spencer Holbrook Luke Fahey nearly picked off in USC territory
 10/31/2026 06:45:02 PM Ohio State moved the football but came up empty after Luke Fahey was intercepted — but a review showed the defender was out of bounds. 
 luke fahey is intercepted pic.twitter.com/fxZNuxg2sf 
— wok (@wokdior) October 31, 2026 
 By: Spencer Holbrook Luke Fahey starts at quarterback for Ohio State
 10/31/2026 06:38:48 PM He’s the fifth true freshman to start a game for the Buckeyes. 
 By: Spencer Holbrook Touchdown, USC
 10/31/2026 06:36:20 PM USC leads on a 69-yard screen. It’s 7-0.
 trent mosley score first to start the game pic.twitter.com/m5MTjWcs5O 
— wok (@wokdior) October 31, 2026 
 By: Spencer Holbrook Ohio State wins the toss, defers
 10/31/2026 06:30:58 PM Ohio State defense will be on the field first.
 Ohio State has won the toss. The Buckeyes are 2-6 on coin tosses this season and 46-53 on coin tosses under Ryan Day. https://t.co/Wkw84J4Pgy 
— Spencer Holbrook (@SpencerHolbrook) October 31, 2026
